Answer: C
Reason: The sequence shows initial bilateral diffuse alveolar infiltrates (Figure 1) that progress to more dense consolidation (Figure 3), followed by significant resolution/clearing of the lungs by day 4 (Figure 4a). This rapid onset and clearance pattern is characteristic of exercise-induced pulmonary haemorrhage (EIPH) rather than infectious pneumonia or chronic lung disease.
